sprint.name: Feature Views - Part 2 (Events, Fleet, CFN Loop) + Test Execution + Charts
sprint.objective: Implement 3 remaining feature views (Events, Fleet, CFN Loop), execute Sprint 3.2 tests, implement Chart.js visualization, achieve ≥80% coverage

acceptance_criteria.description: Events view implemented with timeline, search, filters, and virtual scrolling
acceptance_criteria.verification: Timeline renders events, search filters work, virtual scrolling handles 10K+ events

acceptance_criteria.description: Fleet view implemented with grid/list toggle, aggregation stats, and 1000+ agent support
acceptance_criteria.verification: Fleet overview renders, aggregation shows correct totals, virtual scrolling smooth

acceptance_criteria.description: CFN Loop view implemented with phase visualization, progress tracking, and loop metrics
acceptance_criteria.verification: Phase timeline renders, loop progress shows correctly, metrics update in real-time

acceptance_criteria.description: Sprint 3.2 test suite executed with ≥80% coverage
acceptance_criteria.verification: npm test passes 90 tests, coverage report shows ≥80% lines/functions/branches/statements

acceptance_criteria.description: Chart.js implemented in Performance view (replace placeholders)
acceptance_criteria.verification: CPU, Memory, Agents, Events charts render with real data and time range selection

acceptance_criteria.description: Test coverage ≥80% for all new views (Sprint 3.3 + Sprint 3.2)
acceptance_criteria.verification: Combined coverage report ≥80% across all 6 views

deliverables.name: Events View Component
deliverables.description: Event timeline with search, category filters, severity filters, date range, virtual scrolling for 10K+ events

deliverables.name: Fleet View Component
deliverables.description: Fleet overview with grid/list toggle, swarm aggregation, agent count by type/status, virtual scrolling

deliverables.name: CFN Loop View Component
deliverables.description: CFN Loop dashboard with phase timeline, loop progress (Loop 0-4), confidence scores, validator results

deliverables.name: Chart.js Integration
deliverables.description: 4 Chart.js components: CPUChart, MemoryChart, AgentsChart, EventsChart with responsive design

deliverables.name: Test Execution & Fixes
deliverables.description: Execute Sprint 3.2 tests, fix failures, add missing test IDs, achieve ≥80% coverage

deliverables.name: Test Suites for New Views
deliverables.description: Unit and E2E tests for 3 new views (90 additional tests)

events_view.layout: Timeline with filters sidebar (left 25%) and event list (right 75%)

features.timeline: Vertical timeline with EventTimelineContainer, timestamps, event type icons
features.search: Full-text search on event data, agent ID, event type

filters.date_range: Date picker with presets (today, last 7 days, last 30 days, custom)

features.real_time: WebSocket subscription to 'event:stream', auto-scroll to new events

events_view.state_management: Zustand eventsStore with filters, search, date range

fleet_view.layout: Grid with aggregation cards (top), swarm list with toggle (middle), agent distribution chart (bottom)

features.aggregation: Total agents, active swarms, avg confidence, total tasks completed
features.swarm_list: Virtual scrolling for 100+ swarms, agent count, status breakdown, avg confidence
features.distribution_chart: Pie chart showing agents by type (coder, reviewer, tester, etc.)

fleet_view.state_management: Zustand agentStore with fleet aggregation, swarm list

cfn_loop_view.layout: Phase timeline (top), current loop status (middle), loop metrics cards (bottom)

features.phase_timeline: Horizontal timeline with Phase 1-4, sprint indicators, completion status
features.loop_status: Current loop (0-4), phase name, confidence scores, validator results
features.metrics_cards: Gate threshold, consensus threshold, avg loop 3 confidence, avg loop 2 consensus
features.loop_progress: Progress bars for Loop 3 (agent confidence), Loop 2 (validator consensus)

cfn_loop_view.state_management: New cfnLoopStore with phase data, loop metrics, validator results

cpu_chart.options: Time scale, dual Y-axis, responsive, tooltips

memory_chart.options: Time scale, area fill, responsive, tooltips
